item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani continues his state visit to Germany, having arrived in Berlin on Thursday evening, 1…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani continues his state visit to Germany, having arrived in Berlin on Thursday evening, 19 November, to a 21-gun salute, accompanied by the Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani and an official delegation. He is scheduled to hold talks with President Frank-Walter Steinmeier and Chancellor Friedrich Merz on trade, the economy, investment and regional issues. Experts put bilateral trade at about EUR 2 billion in 2024 and Qatari investment in Germany at more than EUR 25 billion, with over 300 German companies operating in Qatar. German Federal Police President Dieter Romann said the visit could open new avenues for security cooperation and joint training, while Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Hamad, Chairperson of Qatar Museums, highlighted museum partnerships with Berlin.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738621/qatar/hh-the-amir-in-berlin-to-bolster-ties-with-germany · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/amir-arrives-in-germany-1 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265461/latest-news/amir-arrives-in-germany · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265522/business/qatar-germany-ties-poised-to-deepen-through-investment-technology-and-industrial-cooperation-say-experts · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738602/international/amirs-visit-could-open-new-avenues-for-security-ties-german-police-chief · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/sheikha-al-mayassa-highlights-qatar-germany-museum-partnerships-and-cultural-exchange

item.title: Qatar and Pakistan signed in Islamabad, in the presence of Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, a security cooperation agreement betwee…
item.description:
Qatar and Pakistan signed in Islamabad, in the presence of Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, a security cooperation agreement between their interior ministries and a memorandum of understanding between the Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) and Pakistan's federal police on specialised training, exchange of expertise and institutional capacity building. The agreement was signed by Interior Minister and Lekhwiya Commander Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani and his counterpart Mohsin Naqvi; the minister also met Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, the army chief. Sharif thanked Qatar for its continued LNG supplies to Pakistan.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738622/qatar/qatar-pakistan-enhance-security-ties · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/qatar-pakistan-interior-ministries-ink-security-cooperation-pact · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265454/latest-news/interior-minister-meets-pakistans-prime-minister

item.title: Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Official Spokesperson of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, took part in t…
item.description:
Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Official Spokesperson of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, took part in the Mediterranean Dialogues 2026 forum in Naples and called for stronger international cooperation and diplomacy to address the region's crises, addressing Gulf security, maritime routes, the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and Qatar's mediation between Washington and Tehran. On the sidelines he met the EU Special Representative for the Gulf, Luigi Di Maio, and discussed cooperation and de-escalation efforts.

item.title: Qatar opened their FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 campaign with a 2-0 Group A win over Panama at Aspire Zone, both goals coming in stoppage…
item.description:
Qatar opened their FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 campaign with a 2-0 Group A win over Panama at Aspire Zone, both goals coming in stoppage time: a Taha Nassir penalty in the 91st minute and an Abdoulaye Ndiaye goal in the 95th. The tournament features 48 teams and 104 matches, with the final at Ahmad Bin Ali Stadium on 13 December. Other opening-day results included Australia 2-0 Argentina, Uruguay 3-2 Saudi Arabia and Greece 2-1 Egypt.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265515/sports/qatar-strike-twice-in-stoppage-time-to-make-winning-start-at-fifa-u-17-world-cup-2026 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/qatar-snatch-dramatic-late-win-over-panama

item.title: The second Doha International Music and Marching Festival (Doha Tattoo) runs from 14 to 17 December at Katara Cultural Village under the pa…
item.description:
The second Doha International Music and Marching Festival (Doha Tattoo) runs from 14 to 17 December at Katara Cultural Village under the patronage of the Minister of Interior, with nine military and music bands from eight countries alongside Qatari bands and more than 1,000 participants. The UK, Oman and Kazakhstan return, while France, Pakistan, Armenia, Uzbekistan and Egypt take part for the first time.

item.title: New details of Thursday's attack on Riyadh show that the missile struck the Public Investment Fund tower, the tallest skyscraper in King Ab…
item.description:
New details of Thursday's attack on Riyadh show that the missile struck the Public Investment Fund tower, the tallest skyscraper in King Abdullah Financial District at 80 storeys, shattering windows across seven to eight floors and bending parts of the metal facade; entrances to the district were closed and staff evacuated. It was the second hit on the financial district in under two weeks, after an Aramco building was struck on 8 November. The coalition said it had "dealt with a missile threat", and Saudi civil defence confirmed there were no injuries.
Sources: Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199935/world/region/riyadhs-tallest-skyscraper-hit-in-ansar-allah-strike · Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199925/world/region/saudi-sovereign-wealth-fund-tower-damaged-in-riyadh · Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54027/kuwait/kuwait-slams-attacks-on-saudi/ · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/saudi-civil-defense-reports-houthi-attack-on-financial-district-tower-in-riyadh

item.title: Arab condemnations of the attack followed: Kuwait described it as ballistic, cruise-missile and drone attacks violating Saudi sovereignty a…
item.description:
Arab condemnations of the attack followed: Kuwait described it as ballistic, cruise-missile and drone attacks violating Saudi sovereignty and said the Kingdom's security is inseparable from that of Kuwait and the GCC states; Oman condemned the targeting of civilian and economic facilities and called for an end to escalation, diplomatic dialogue and addressing the root causes of tension; and Egypt said Saudi security is part of its own national security and demanded an immediate halt to the attacks.

item.title: Oman celebrates its National Day today, marking the anniversary of Imam Ahmed bin Said Al Busaidy's accession in 1744, and His Majesty Sult…
item.description:
Oman celebrates its National Day today, marking the anniversary of Imam Ahmed bin Said Al Busaidy's accession in 1744, and His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik toured wilayats in North A'Sharqiyah and A'Dakhiliyah on Thursday evening. Official figures show average annual growth of about 3.2% in 2021–2025, public debt down from 65.9% to 34.6% of GDP, an investment-grade BBB- rating with a stable outlook, and a 52% rise in cargo at Sohar Port in the first half of 2026. Drone shows are staged at 8pm today in Muscat and Salalah and tomorrow in Manah, and Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar congratulated the Sultanate, pledging to strengthen the strategic partnership.
Sources: Oman Observer (ONA) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199868/oman/oman-to-mark-national-day-on-friday-nov-20 · Times of Oman (ONA) https://timesofoman.com/article/179313-oman-marks-national-day-amid-renewed-renaissance-rising-global-competitiveness-distinguished-development-record · Times of Oman (ONA) https://timesofoman.com/article/179374-hm-the-sultan-goes-on-inspection-tour-to-several-wilayats-in-north-asharqiyah-adakhiliyah-governorates · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199874/oman/community/national-day-drone-shows-planned-in-muscat-salalah-and-manah · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179376-india-extends-greetings-to-oman-on-national-day-jaishankar-reaffirms-commitment-to-strengthen-strategic-partnership

item.title: Brent rose 24 cents (0.3%) on Friday morning to $92.22 a barrel and US crude for December gained 0.2% to $83.40, but both benchmarks are he…
item.description:
Brent rose 24 cents (0.3%) on Friday morning to $92.22 a barrel and US crude for December gained 0.2% to $83.40, but both benchmarks are heading for a third straight weekly loss: about 3.5% for Brent and about 6% for US crude. Houthi attacks on Riyadh and disruption to tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz remain the only support against demand worries.

item.title: Gold prices in Egypt fell on Friday morning as the global ounce dropped more than 4.5% to around $3,520, with the most-traded 21-carat gram…
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt fell on Friday morning as the global ounce dropped more than 4.5% to around $3,520, with the most-traded 21-carat gram at EGP 5,635–5,730 depending on the source, down from EGP 5,750 on Thursday morning. Globally, the metal is heading for its worst week in eight months on bets of a US rate hike in December.

item.title: This week completes a mixed picture of Egypt's economy: GDP growth of 4.9% in the first quarter of the fiscal year (July–September) with Su…
item.description:
This week completes a mixed picture of Egypt's economy: GDP growth of 4.9% in the first quarter of the fiscal year (July–September) with Suez Canal activity up 47.5%, against unemployment rising to 6.0% in the third quarter from 5.8%, according to the planning minister and CAPMAS. External debt of $166.7 billion remains the biggest challenge to this recovery.

item.title: The precious-metals slide accelerated on Friday morning, with gold down more than 4.5% to around $3,520 an ounce at 06:30 CET, heading for …
item.description:
The precious-metals slide accelerated on Friday morning, with gold down more than 4.5% to around $3,520 an ounce at 06:30 CET, heading for its worst week in eight months, and silver plunging 7% to $41.24. Gold had ended Thursday's New York session at $3,625.50, as markets priced about a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point hike in December.

item.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv killed at least one person and injured four, and damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies: windows at the Austrian …
item.description:
Russian strikes on Kyiv killed at least one person and injured four, and damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies: windows at the Austrian embassy were shattered in a blast around 4:30pm with about ten people inside, none hurt, and a drone came down near the Dutch embassy in Podilskyi district. Russia launched 98 drones and anti-ship missiles, and EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Russia's representative in Brussels would be summoned.
Sources: The Copenhagen Post https://cphpost.dk/2026-11-20/global/russian-strikes-on-kyiv-kill-one-and-damage-austrian-and-dutch-embassies/ · Africanews https://www.africanews.com/amp/2026/11/20/ukraine-russian-strikes-damage-austrian-and-dutch-embassies-in-kyiv/ · The Kyiv Independent https://kyivindependent.com/breaking-dutch-embassy-damaged-in-russian-drone-strike-on-kyiv/

item.title: Hungary is set to lift its objection to opening the last two negotiating clusters in Ukraine's and Moldova's EU accession path (agriculture…
item.description:
Hungary is set to lift its objection to opening the last two negotiating clusters in Ukraine's and Moldova's EU accession path (agriculture and the green agenda) at today's meeting of EU ambassadors, after blocking them on 20 October and 10 November. Diplomats expect all six clusters to open in December 2026, while the Commission sends its Moldova report in the week starting 23 November.
Sources: Euronews (Yahoo) https://ca.news.yahoo.com/hungary-drop-veto-ukraine-remaining-060033511.html · Censor.NET https://censor.net/en/news/4034672/hungary-has-unblocked-ukraine-s-eu-accession-negotiations · Daily News Hungary https://dailynewshungary.com/hungary-lifts-veto-ukraine-eu-join/

item.title: The US administration sold the first deep-sea mining leases in American history, covering two areas of about 31 million acres (12.5 million…
item.description:
The US administration sold the first deep-sea mining leases in American history, covering two areas of about 31 million acres (12.5 million hectares) off American Samoa for a combined $6 million, despite a ruling on Monday by Judge Jill Otake in Hawaii that approval of the sale violated the Endangered Species Act. Interior Secretary Doug Burgum defended the sale, and Earthjustice vowed to seek to have the leases voided.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/us-sells-first-deep-sea-mining-leases-off-american-samoa-days-after-court-ruled-against-pr · 24NewsHD (AFP) https://www.24newshd.tv/19-Nov-2026/us-auctions-first-ever-deep-sea-mining-leases
